Q: What is the return window for most products?
A: Most products can be returned within 7 days of delivery, except final-sale items which are marked as non-returnable on the product page.

Q: How do I initiate a return?
A: Go to "My Orders > Return Item", select the reason, and choose a pickup slot; a prepaid return label isn't needed as pickup is doorstep.

Q: Can I exchange a product for a different size instead of returning it?
A: Yes, select "Exchange" instead of "Return" on the order page, subject to stock availability of the new size.

Q: When will I get my refund after a return?
A: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after the returned item passes quality inspection at our warehouse.

Q: Are all products eligible for return?
A: Most products are eligible except innerwear, personal care items, and products explicitly marked "non-returnable" on the product page.

Q: Do I need the original packaging to return an item?
A: Yes, items should be returned with original tags, packaging, and accessories intact for the return to be accepted.

Q: Can I return a product if I just don't like it?
A: Yes, "change of mind" returns are accepted within the standard return window as long as the item is unused and in original condition.

Q: What happens if my returned item fails quality inspection?
A: If the item doesn't meet return conditions (e.g., used, damaged, missing parts), it will be shipped back to you instead of being refunded.

Q: Can I return only part of a multi-item order?
A: Yes, you can select specific items from an order to return; the rest of the order remains unaffected.

Q: How long do I have to exchange a product?
A: Exchanges follow the same window as returns — typically 7 days from delivery, unless stated otherwise on the product page.

Q: Will I get a refund to my original payment method or store credit?
A: Refunds are issued to your original payment method by default; store credit is offered as a faster alternative on request.

Q: Can I return a gifted item without the original buyer?
A: Yes, gifted items can be returned using the order ID shared by the gifter; refunds for gifted items are issued as store credit.

Q: Who pays for return shipping?
A: Return pickup is free for defective, damaged, or incorrectly shipped items. For change-of-mind returns, a small pickup fee may be deducted from your refund — this is shown before you confirm the return.

Q: Are sale or clearance items eligible for return?
A: Yes, unless an item is specifically marked "Final Sale" on the product page at the time of purchase — final sale items are not eligible for return or exchange.

Q: What's the difference between a return and a warranty claim?
A: Returns apply within the standard return window after delivery. Manufacturer warranty claims (for defects that appear later) are handled separately — contact support with your order ID and we'll guide you through the manufacturer's warranty process.

Q: Can international orders be returned the same way as domestic ones?
A: Yes, international orders follow the same return window and process, though pickup may take a few extra days depending on your courier region.
